scope: Dial ESP32-S3 NVS prop_key/shared runtime HMAC key
DinMeter ESP32-S3 Preferences prop_key/shared runtime HMAC key
decision: Runtime key at rest is permitted only with this explicit project waiver until target-specific flash/NVS protection is enabled and verified.
rationale: Current checked-in Dial sdkconfig has secure boot and flash encryption disabled, and DinMeter PlatformIO protection cannot be proven statically. Release gates must not silently accept this posture.
required_evidence: only SHA-256 fingerprints recorded in notes
no prop_key.nvs.csv, prop_key_bytes.h, prop_key.nvs.bin, readback/*.bin, or raw key files committed
hardware protection posture recorded for each shipped target

din_rx_static_posture.partition_table: board default unless firmware/din-rx/platformio.ini adds board_build.partitions
